review.reviewer: Claude, maintainer-authorized source and dependency review (AF-CTR-05 delegated author, E1b); PR review is recorded separately
review.rationale: AF-CTR-05 part E1b (signed calls and results on the node channel; no routed API), tested with REAL PostgreSQL, the REAL composed center and WebSocket server, the Contracts golden vectors byte for byte and a MOCKED node (nodetest's channel client, honest or hostile); production stays dark (no environment enables the relay surface): the successor of the admission at cloud-release-r95. The Go sources of the center change: package hub gains the routing seam hub.Call (the CallHeader signed with the newest valid held command key under the routed-call domain string, the ChannelResult verified against the connection's installation key under the routed-result domain string, the response forwarded unchanged, a node's refusal rebuilt from its closed fields, a violation closed 4403), the in-flight bounds per node and per center, the relay nonces and the relay assertion's verifier, and a hand-written mirror of the contract's validators (the Go bindings carry none); package arc gains node_offline, node_unreachable and the relay assertion's refusal; the identity policy gains routedInFlightPerNode and routedInFlightPerCenter; the health document names the signing kid. The Worker sources and the bundle are unchanged. The tests, the test data (the vendored Contracts vectors and catalogue) and the documents are not part of the image or the bundle. No Go module, npm package, base image, toolchain or legal file changes. The Worker sources are unchanged; the Worker record follows the new profile. It supersedes the admission at cloud-release-r95.
